notes: Product menus on the category pages are JS-rendered; the list was taken from the official sitemap (https://www.aia.com.sg/en/sitemap.xml) and each page fetched with status 200.
AIA's server hangs on scripted requests that omit an Accept-Language header; fetch_page.py sends one and works.
AIA Pro Lifetime Protector (II) appears under both Whole Life and Investment-Linked menus, and AIA Guaranteed Protect Plus (IV) under both Whole Life and Participating Savings; each is listed once.
AIA Platinum Retirement Elite, Wealth Elite 2.0, Wealth Legacy and Wealth Venture 3.0 appear under both the Platinum and Investment-Linked menus; listed once with the Investment-Linked URL.
AIA Platinum AccidentCare and AIA Platinum International Health also appear under the Platinum Accident & Health menu with the same name; listed once.

AIA Max VitalHealth Pro riders have no page of their own; they are described on the AIA HealthShield Gold Max page. Other HealthShield riders named on the 1 Oct 2026 updates page (VitalHealth A / A Value, VitalCare, B, B Lite, Max A Cancer Care Booster) were not listed separately.

AIA HealthShield Gold Max has revisions effective 1 October 2026 (premium revisions, new high-cost drug and stereotactic radiosurgery benefits); see its oct2026-updates page. MOH rider revisions sit on a separate moh-updates-ip-riders page not reviewed here.
AIA Protect 3 is sold only to existing AIA customers and their spouses and children.
AIA Platinum International Health is an international private medical plan open to non-residents, not an Integrated Shield Plan; filed under hospitalisation as the nearest category.
Critical Cover Accelerator and Early Critical Cover Accelerator riders are mentioned on the AIA Life Dividends page but have no page or PDF of their own, so are not listed.

Skipped as out of scope: Employee Benefits, Corporate Medical, Corporate International Medical, Travel and Home pages; protectplus-cover, device-cover and wanderplus-cover are customer-support pages. Retirement Solutions and Plan360 pages are marketing/planning pages, not products.
Channel is recorded as unknown for non-Direct products because the pages do not state a channel; the two DIRECT plans are sold online via AIA's Direct Purchase platform.
Some Platinum-tier and savings plans are sold in US$ or S$/US$; noted in facts where the page shows it.
